text: Meet envoy. Find civic services, ask a question, and send feedback to Envoy’s review team from one place.
ttsText: Meet onvoy. Find civic services, ask a question, and send feedback to Onvoy’s review team from one place.

text: The jobs board lists current official vacancies and closing dates. Choose a role, prepare for the official site, then open the publisher’s application page. Nearby maps seventy-eight service locations. Consultations also link to official sources.
Describe a local concern in plain language. The assistant can find context and prepare an editable report proposal. Nothing is sent until the resident reviews it and chooses to submit.
The feedback form makes the destination clear before submission. Reports enter Envoy’s own review queue, not a government office. The resident receives a private receipt for follow-up.

text: For voice, the Worker signs a short-lived ElevenLabs session. In a verified call, a fictional streetlight concern was transcribed and the agent asked for the nearest intersection. A report still requires resident review; web microphone handoff remains unverified.

D1 retains report bodies. An outbox sends only event metadata to Tiger for trends. A read-only query on September twenty-sixth found four delivered events and four aggregated events. That is historical delivery evidence, not a live staff dashboard.

The native SwiftUI app wires Presage SmartSpectra to an optional breathing check. It asks for camera consent and can offer a quieter layout. The simulator build works; a live reading still needs verification on a physical iPhone.

Auth0 hosts organization sign-in. The Worker validates token signature, issuer, and audience, then checks D1 membership and scopes. Staff tools can triage reports, assign them, and respond inside Envoy. Hosted login is configured; a real scoped staff action remains unverified.
